name: fortrip
description: Find and book hotels worldwide: compare live room rates, pay securely, and check or cancel your bookings.

interface.longDescription:
Fortrip helps you find and book hotels around the world without leaving the chat. Search by city, neighborhood, hotel name or brand, see what a hotel offers, and compare live room rates, meals and cancellation terms side by side.

When you've picked a room, the assistant shows you the total price and the terms and waits for your OK. You then pay on a secure payment page, and nothing is charged until you do. You can check your bookings at any time and cancel one under its cancellation terms; the assistant tells you the fee and the refund first.

You need a Fortrip account. Fortrip books hotels only for now: flights, activities and changes to an existing booking aren't supported.
defaultPrompt: Find 5-star hotels in Bangkok near the river for 2 adults, 2 nights next month.
Compare live offers with free cancellation at three Shanghai hotels near the Bund.
Plan a split stay in Tokyo and Kyoto on a budget of 200 USD per night.

positive.description: Search hotels in a city for given dates
positive.prompt: Find 5-star hotels in Bangkok for 2 adults, checking in 30 days from today for 2 nights, with prices in USD.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_hotels with a place_name destination for Bangkok in Thailand, the requested dates and party, filters.stars with a minimum of 5 and currency USD, and lists matching 5-star Bangkok hotels with their indicative price per room per night in USD, saying these are indicative prices and live offers still need to be checked.

positive.prompt: I'm staying at Anantara Riverside Bangkok Resort for 2 nights, checking in 30 days from today. What are its check-in and check-out times, address and facilities?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the hotel with search_hotels for those dates, then calls get_hotel and reports its address, check-in and check-out times and facilities from the catalogue. It doesn't present a search price as a live rate or say that a room is available.

positive.description: Compare live rates and cancellation terms
positive.prompt: Show live offers with free cancellation at Anantara Riverside Bangkok Resort for 2 adults in 1 room, 2 nights starting 45 days from today, with the amounts in CNY.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the hotel with search_hotels, calls get_hotel_offers for it with the dates, 1 room of 2 adults, filters.requireFreeCancellation and currency CNY, and lists offers with their room, meals, free-cancellation deadline and price.total in CNY, which is what is charged. If the hotel has no free-cancellation offer for those dates, it says so. If the answer is currency_unavailable, it says CNY prices aren't available yet and offers USD prices.

positive.description: Compare two check-in dates within a budget
positive.prompt: I need 3 nights in Shanghai for 2 adults in 1 room, checking in either 30 or 37 days from today, for under 150 USD per night. Which dates and hotels give the best value?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_hotels for Shanghai for each check-in date with filters.price.maxPerRoomNight of 150 USD, then get_hotel_offers for a shortlist of the results on each date. It compares each offer's price.total per night (price.total divided by 3 nights, for 1 room) with the 150 USD budget and recommends options within it, each with its dates, price.total in USD, meals and cancellation terms. It treats search prices as indicative and calls a hotel available only when get_hotel_offers returned an offer for it.

positive.description: Create a booking payment link after confirmation
positive.prompt: Book the cheapest free-cancellation room at Anantara Riverside Bangkok Resort for 1 adult in 1 room, 2 nights starting 60 days from today. Guest: John Smith, email john.smith@example.com, phone +1 415 555 0100.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the hotel, calls get_hotel_offers with filters.requireFreeCancellation, and calls book_hotel with the cheapest free-cancellation offer, the guest in room 1 and the contact's name, email and phone. It shows the stay, the price.total with its currency, the meals, cancellation rules, confirmation mode and pay-at-hotel fees, and asks the user to confirm. Only after the user confirms does it give the payment.url link, a Fortrip page on fortrip.ai that recaps the order and continues to payment. Nothing is charged unless the user pays there. If no free-cancellation offer is available, it says so and asks how to proceed instead of ordering another offer.

negative.description: Flights are out of scope: Fortrip only searches and books hotels.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from Shanghai to Bangkok next Friday.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no Fortrip tool. Says that Fortrip can't search or book flights.

negative.description: Saving a payment card isn't supported: the plugin never handles card details, and each booking is paid on its own, by its payment link or a single-use token the user approves in their Link wallet.
negative.prompt: Save my credit card to my Fortrip account so my next hotel booking is charged automatically.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no Fortrip tool and doesn't ask for card details. Explains that it can't save a card to the Fortrip account or charge it, and that each order is paid on its own: on the Fortrip payment page its payment link opens, or with a single-use token the user approves in their Link wallet.

negative.description: The tools can't change an existing booking's dates, room or guests; Fortrip support handles that by email.
negative.prompt: Move my hotel booking in Bangkok to next week.
negative.expected_behavior: Doesn't cancel or order anything. Explains that it can't change an existing order, and tells the user to email info@fortrip.ai with the order's reference.

review.commerce_description: Users can book hotel stays. book_hotel creates an unpaid order for one offer and returns a link to a Fortrip page on fortrip.ai that recaps the order and its terms; the user completes payment there: a USD order by card through Stripe Checkout or by Alipay or WeChat Pay, a CNY order by Alipay, WeChat Pay or a bank card from mainland China. For a USD order, pay_order can also open an Alipay or WeChat Pay payment, or pay with a single-use Stripe shared payment token the user approves in their Link wallet (US and Canadian accounts, orders up to $500), held until the hotel confirms. Before giving the link or paying, the assistant shows the amount and currency charged, the meals, cancellation rules and pay-at-hotel fees, and waits for the user to confirm. The plugin refuses card numbers, and nothing is charged without the user's approval on the payment page or in their wallet.

publication.release_notes: Choose USD or, where available, CNY for prices and payment, and pay by card, Alipay or WeChat Pay. You can also close an unpaid booking you no longer want.

zh-CN.subtitle: 搜索并预订酒店
zh-CN.description:
Fortrip 让你在对话里直接找酒店、订酒店。按城市、街区、酒店名或品牌搜索，查看酒店详情，并排比较实时房价、餐食和取消政策。

选好房间后，助手会先告诉你总价和各项条款，等你确认。之后你在安全的付款页面完成付款，付款之前不会扣任何钱。你可以随时查看自己的预订，也可以按取消政策取消，助手会先告诉你违约金和退款金额。

需要 Fortrip 账号。目前只支持酒店，暂不支持机票、活动和修改已有预订。
